passages.original: Tharsis vel regio Indiae est, ut vult Josephus : vel certe, omne pelagus Tharsis appellatur, et coeli habet similitudinem (Jerem. X).
passages.english: Tharshish is either a region of India, as Josephus holds, or else the whole open sea is called Tharshish, and it has the likeness of the sky (Jer. 10).
passages.notes: "Tharsis" is the biblical Tarshish (Tharshish). The clause "it has the likeness of the sky" apparently refers to the sea's colour, by which the name was also understood as a precious stone. The edition's reference is to Jeremiah 10, where silver from Tarshish is mentioned.
